topIssues.title: Add Sequencer-Defined Metering Design Doc
topIssues.author: joshklop
topIssues.body:
* Clearly define the problem.
* Introduce the design. Summarizing existing documents with a bit more detail is probably sufficient.
* Include an implementation plan that sketches engineering details for a v0 design.
* Include a benchmarking/evaluation plan that details how the effectiveness of a PoC will be measured.

Existing documents that can be used for inspiration:

* [A New Gas Model for the OP Stack](https://www.notion.so/oplabs/external-draft-A-New-Gas-Model-for-the-OP-Stack-2c8f153ee16280ca9b23dbb4195c2bbb?source=copy_link)
* [Fee Rebates](https://www.notion.so/oplabs/Fee-Rebates-2c6f153ee162804ab80bfc48ea85095d?source=copy_link)
